verdict.rationale: Copilot documents agentic multi-step task execution (Cowork 'help with bigger, multi-step tasks and deliver completed to-dos') and some proactive behavior (memory-based proactive research suggestions), suggesting rudimentary autonomy, but there is no documentation of user-configurable scheduled or trigger-based automations that run persistently in the background without prompting. Missing for 10: explicit scheduling/trigger setup, recurring background execution, and independent confirmation that these run unattended rather than being invoked per-session.
